about.title: Not just code. Operational results.
about.bodyBefore: Software engineer with dual degrees in
about.bodyAfter: , an MBA in Data Science from USP-Esalq, and a track record built in real operations: logistics software at RCM, industrial software development at WEG, and IT leadership at Legacy Eco Group. Today I am the founder of Kodeskill, where I lead architecture and build SaaS and AI products end to end: interfaces, APIs, PostgreSQL data, queues, and deployment.

paragraphs: LevFlow: multi-tenant financial SaaS on Next.js in a Turborepo monorepo, with a hexagonal domain, PostgreSQL on Supabase with Drizzle, Upstash QStash queues, Pagar.me billing, and a pipeline with Playwright, Vitest, and CodeQL. Tenant isolation is designed with row-level security: each company sees only its own data.

Framefy: multi-user, multi-company SaaS that generates Instagram carousels and posts with AI, with plans, subscriptions, and credits. The NestJS backend (Fastify, CQRS) processes text and image jobs on BullMQ queues with OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini, in Docker containers.

MasterClass: separate WhatsApp funnel automation system. Consolidated the six flows that ran on n8n (group creation and cleanup, message and video dispatch, individual signup, and conversation processing) into one NestJS (Express) app, with Z-API for WhatsApp, ManyChat webhooks, a RabbitMQ lead queue, and Claude for replies. Google Sheets remains the source for events and copy.

Digital directory (architecture and specification; build planned): business and services listing in a marketplace model for a network of ~100 congregations, designed for ~20K providers, ~1M searches/month. Led architecture and wrote ADRs: Go REST API (OpenAPI 3.1 from code, CI contract gate); PostgreSQL with PostGIS, full-text search, deny-by-default RLS; River outbox; Zitadel OIDC; Next.js PWA; React Native/Expo; Turborepo. Targets: p95 ≤ 300 ms, WCAG 2.2 AA; sensitive-data privacy by design (LGPD art. 11, GDPR art. 9). Orchestrated 10 AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor) to produce the spec.
In parallel with Kodeskill, I structured the IT department and consolidated the group’s systems, with data and processes in one place.
I led the digitization of operational steps, AI deployment, and mentoring for managers and teams.
Estimated savings of about R$ 125K per year (≈ US$23K) on software licenses.
Joined in 02/2021 as a Process Engineering intern on the Industry 4.0 team and was promoted to analyst in 01/2022.

Built applications, integrations, and dashboards that centralized data from 48 lines across 4 factories (Bluffton/US, Belém/PA, and two plants in Linhares/ES) and deliver production data to management, branches, and headquarters without the manual end-of-day close.
Estimated gains of about R$ 300K per year (≈ US$55K) from process, accuracy, maintenance, and centralized data, with rollout toward Argentina, Algeria, and China.
Across Technology and Logistics, I built a freight comparator that crosses price tables, destination, weight, volume, cargo type, fees, and commercial terms.
The team began comparing carriers before each contract and picking the best cost-benefit option.
Over nine months of use, transportation costs fell by more than R$ 1.2 million (≈ US$221K).

Built a freight comparator at RCM that cut freight costs by R$ 1.2M+ (≈ US$221K) in nine months, and WEG applications centralizing data from 48 lines across 4 factories (Brazil and US), with estimated gains of R$ 300K (≈ US$55K) per year. As IT lead at Legacy Eco Group, saved an estimated R$ 125K (≈ US$23K) yearly in licenses. Kodeskill founder, leading architecture and system design for multi-tenant SaaS and AI products. B.Sc. Computer Science and Electrical Engineering; MBA Data Science.
